technique_name: Make an outline for a business plan
description:
I. Introduction 
A. Overview of Business Concept
B. Target Customer
C. Mission Statement

II. Market Analysis 
A. Industry Overview
B. Target Market
C. Analyze Competitors

III. Strategy and Implementation 
A. Company Structure
B. Services Offered
C. Location
D. Management and Employees

IV. Financial Plan 
A. Revenue Projection
B. Cost Structure
C. Funding
D. Profit and Loss Projection
example: A business plan to open a coffee shop
